text:
Iko Mbaụwa nke 1962 nke FIFA mere na Chile site na 30 May ruo 17 June, nke mbụ na nanị oge mba South America ahụ kwadoro asọmpi ahụ. Ndị otu iri na isii so na ya, e kewara ha n’ime otu anọ nke otu anọ; ndị abụọ kacha elu n’otu ọ bụla gara n’ọkwa nkwụsị nke otu onye meriri onye ọzọ nke ụzọ anọ, ụzọ abụọ, egwuregwu nke atọ na nke ikpeazụ. Ọ bụ World Cup mbụ e jiri nkezi goolu kewaa ndị otu nwere otu akara, ihe eji edozi ọnọdụ otu. Asọmpi ahụ bụ nke nchekwa pụrụ iche: nkezi goolu dara ruo 2.78 goolu kwa egwuregwu, na-aga n’ihu na mbelata, ebe ngụkọta ndị bịara ruru 893,172 n’ime asọmpi ahụ, nkezi ihe dị ka 27,912 kwa egwuregwu.

Brazil, ndị mmeri nke 1958, bịara dị ka ndị a na-atụ anya mana ha tụfuru kpakpando ha mgbe Pelé merụrụ ahụ n’oge otu wee kwụsị iso. Amarildo batara dị ka onye nọchiri ya. Garrincha ghọrọ onye na-edu Brazil, na-ekerịta ọnụọgụgụ goolu anọ nke asọmpi ahụ. A na-ahụ ya dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma n’asọmpi ahụ, na-ebu otu ahụ mgbe mmerụ ahụ nke Pelé gasịrị, ọ bụ ezie na ọ nweghị Golden Ball ọ bụla na 1962. Ndị goolu anọ ahụ bụ ndị isii: Garrincha na Vavá nke Brazil, Leonel Sánchez nke Chile, Flórián Albert nke Hungary, Valentin Ivanov nke Soviet Union na Dražan Jerković nke Yugoslavia.

Egwuregwu ikpeazụ mere na 17 June na Estadio Nacional na Santiago n’ihu ndị na-ekiri 68,679, ebe Brazil zutere Czechoslovakia. Masopust mepere goolu maka Czechoslovakia, mana Brazil zaghachiri site n’aka Amarildo, Zito na Vavá iji merie 3–1 wee nweta aha nke abụọ n’usoro. Site n’ime nke a, Brazil ghọrọ mba nke abụọ jigidere Iko Mbaụwa, mgbe Italy gasịrị na 1934 na 1938. Czechoslovakia mechara dị ka ndị nke abụọ. Ndị nwe ụlọ, Chile, wepụtara ebe nke atọ site n’ịmeri Yugoslavia 1–0, ebe Yugoslavia nọ n’ọnọdụ nke anọ. Otu n’ime akụkọ na-adịgide adịgide nke asọmpi ahụ bụ ihe a na-akpọ ‘Battle of Santiago’, egwuregwu otu nwere ime ihe ike nke Chile na Italy, nke ndị nwe ụlọ meriri 2–0.
